title: Global functions on a proper reduced scheme over an algebraically closed field
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and let $X$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-scheme-over-base] whose structure morphism is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Assume that $X$ is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. The set $C$ of connected components (maximal nonempty connected subsets) of $X$ [def-weil-connected-scheme] is finite, its members are open and closed, and the map of $k$-algebras $\prod_{c\in C}k\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ that sends $(a_c)$ to the section with constant value $a_c$ on the open subscheme $c$ is an isomorphism. If $X$ is empty, $C$ is empty and both rings are the zero ring, with the product interpreted as the empty product.
